description: 浦安市消防施設一覧 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 浦安市. 浦安市消防本部・出張所・浦安市消防団詰所・消防団器具置き場の所在地などの一覧です。. Coverage: 浦安市. The portal files it under the publisher 浦安市. Its tags are マップ情報, 施設, 災害. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-10-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
